decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system draws directly on the firm's office furniture and quality-testing expertise, so management can read its results and keep refining it as flexible workplaces gain importance.
The chair family sits at the core of the firm's craftsmanship and designer collaboration, which makes market feedback easy to absorb and the line easy to keep developing.
The carpet floor cushions build on the firm's material and upholstery knowledge, though as a niche accessory they remain the most likely candidate for range trimming.

The rug collection is distant from the firm's core knowledge, but after several years of learning through designer cooperation and its flagship role in the curated-materials direction, the firm has built enough capacity to keep it.
